name: Kartik Garg
summary:
Application Security Consultant and Penetration Tester with
3+ years of hands-on experience across Web, API, mobile
(Android & IOS) and network environments and SAST. Skilled
in identifying real-world vulnerabilities through VAPT,
business logic abuse and manual exploitation techniques
across complex application flows.
Experienced in securing 100+ applications across banking and
enterprise environments, with strong contributions in bug
bounty and VDP programs including Hall of Fame recognition
and CVE credits. Proficient in automation using Bash and
Python to streamline security testing and improve operational
efficiency.
Currently focused on advancing expertise in cloud security,
red teaming and reverse engineering to better understand
modern attack techniques and evolving attack surfaces.
